name: Application Keeps Crashing
description: Safely diagnose repeated application freezes, crashes, and startup failures.

prepare.title: Protect your work first
prepare.instruction: Save work in other applications. Note the affected application's name and what you were doing when it failed. Do not download cleanup or repair utilities.
prepare.help_text: A repeatable description helps distinguish a damaged application from a file-specific or system-wide problem.

failure_type.question: What happens when you use the application?

crashes.label: It opens, then closes or freezes

one_file.label: It fails with one particular file

test_other_file.title: Test a different file safely
test_other_file.instruction: Leave the original file unchanged. Open a small, known-good file of the same type or create a blank document, then perform the same basic action.
test_other_file.help_text: This separates an application problem from a damaged, oversized, or unsupported file.

other_file_result.question: Does the application work with the other file?

file_specific.title: The issue appears file-specific
file_specific.message: The application works with other files. Restore an earlier copy, ask the file owner to recreate it, or use the application's built-in repair or recovery option. Keep the original for recovery and do not overwrite it.

check_scope.question: Are other applications also freezing or closing?

system_wide.title: Use the computer performance workflow
system_wide.message: Multiple applications are affected, which suggests a broader Windows resource or stability issue. Open Computer Running Slowly and record any sustained CPU, memory, or disk use.

restart_application.title: Close and reopen the application
restart_application.instruction: Close the application normally. If it remains frozen, open Task Manager with Ctrl+Shift+Esc, select only the affected application, choose End task, wait ten seconds, and reopen it.
restart_application.help_text: Restarting clears the application's temporary state without changing its settings or files.

restart_result.question: Does the application now work normally?

resolved_restart.title: Temporary application problem cleared
resolved_restart.message: The application is responding again. If the problem returns, note the exact action, file, and error message that preceded it.

restart_computer.title: Restart Windows
restart_computer.instruction: Save all open work, select Start > Power > Restart, sign back in, and test the application before opening other programs.
restart_computer.help_text: A restart reloads application dependencies and clears locked temporary resources.

computer_restart_result.question: Does the application work after restarting Windows?

check_update.title: Check for an approved application update
check_update.instruction: Use the application's Help or About menu, Microsoft Store, or your organization's software portal to check for an update. Do not download installers from advertisements or unfamiliar sites.
check_update.help_text: A vendor update may correct a known compatibility or stability defect.

test_update.title: Test after the update
test_update.instruction: Restart the application and repeat the action that previously caused the failure using noncritical data when possible.

resolved_update.title: Application stability restored
resolved_update.message: The approved update corrected the problem. Continue using the supported update source and monitor for recurrence.

escalate.title: Application support is recommended
escalate.message: Record the application version, Windows version, exact error text, affected file or action, and time of the latest failure. A technician can review logs, repair the installation, or reinstall it without risking user data.
